source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie,
Here's a summary of my feedback:
\* I definitely like examples 1 and 2 over 3 and 4.
\* I do like the "dark mode" landing page. It looks tech but sophisticated. The purple background you created for 1 and 2 looks great.
\* Highlighting the first sentence of the hero text works really well, better than the tag line.
\* I like the look of Alan Sans, at least in the headline text. It feels warmer and more approachable (now they've got me at it!).
\* Surprisingly (to me) the green color works well for buttons.
\* I'm in two minds over the single color vs two color logo
\* Not sure if the screens are a place holder. They could be an interesting approach to explore.
\* Did you envisage adding the rest of the initial copy to the landing page or moving it to follow-on pages?
\* Do you plan to have a common page footer?
I'm looking forward to your next updates.
Mark
